mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are an aspect of material provision which require care."
Interest tables and displays are an aspect of material provision which require care.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a term that describes the education of young children from birth through age eight."
Early Childhood Education is a term that describes the education of young children from birth through age eight.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of supporting, guiding, and facilitating development and learning."
The teacher's role is one of supporting, guiding, and facilitating development and learning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to all the various implicit values, norms and practices in the educational system."
Hidden curriculum refers to all the various implicit values, norms and practices in the educational system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the people with the most intimate knowledge of the curriculum and the greatest commitment to it."
The designers are the people with the most intimate knowledge of the curriculum and the greatest commitment to it.

The TMA is the continuous assessment component of your course.
